### Dataset Summary

This is a new presentation of the corpus [Catalan Common Voice v17 - metadata annotated version](https://huggingface.co/datasets/projecte-aina/annotated_catalan_common_voice_v17) 
with the splits redefined to benchmark ASR models with various Catalan accents: 
From the validate
reputation: Based on Mozilla Common Voice and broadly trusted for ASR work; this Catalan-accents split is a community-curated variant with moderate adoption for accent-robustness evaluation.
